items.title: Toaster

items.name: scroll-area

.caps-surface::before.boxShadow:
var(
      --stipe-shadow-edge,
      inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.48)),
      inset 1px 0 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.18)),
      inset 0 -1px 0
        color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 10%, transparent)
    )

.caps-surface::after.boxShadow:
var(
      --stipe-shadow-inset,
      inset 0 1px 0
        color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 18%, transparent),
      inset 0 var(--caps-surface-inset) var(--caps-surface-inset)
        oklch(0% 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.16)),
      inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0% 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.08)),
      inset -1px -1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.16))
    )

.caps-screen.--caps-control-range-mask:
repeating-linear-gradient(
      to right,
      black 0 var(--caps-control-segment),
      transparent var(--caps-control-segment)
        calc(var(--caps-control-segment) + var(--caps-control-segment-gap))
    )

.caps-input,.caps-input:disabled.transition:
border-color var(--stipe-motion-fast) ease,

inset 0 0.6cqi 1.8cqi -0.4cqi var(--card-shadow),
      inset 0 0 0 0.6cqi color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-window) 70%, transparent)

var(--card-rule-width) solid
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent) 45%, transparent)

var(--card-rule-width) solid
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-rule) 35%, transparent)

var(--card-rule-width) dotted
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-rule) 60%, transparent)

.caps-cigarette-card-sources.borderTop:
